summary: Master the complexities of pension administration and management through our specialized course. Elevate your skills and become a valuable asset in the industry
lede: Pension administration training helps professionals who support retirement plans manage member records, contributions, benefit cases, and operational controls. It covers translating eligibility rules into processes, reconciling payroll contributions and investigating variances, and applying checks to benefit calculations and payments. Learners also practise tracking service performance and preparing governance and management reports.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already support pension operations and now need stronger control, reporting, and governance capability.
prerequisites: Recommended prerequisites: working knowledge of pension or retirement plan operations, basic familiarity with member records and contribution processing, and experience with benefits administration, payroll coordination, finance, HR, or scheme governance. You should be comfortable reviewing operational reports and policy documents. No coding is required. Advanced topics such as governance design, risk controls, and reporting automation are taught at the operational application level, with conceptual exposure to broader plan design and investment oversight where relevant.
